content.text:
The site looks like the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass. I fixed three bad values in `site/css/styles.css`:

- **`.container` width:** it was `50%` and is now `100%`. This was the main bug. It squeezed the page into a narrow column on phones.
- **`.my-5` top margin:** it was `1.5rem` and is now `3rem`. This removed 24px of vertical spacing.
- **`.px-lg-5` left padding:** it was `4.5rem` and is now `3rem`. This had pushed the content on desktop 24px to the right of the navbar.

The repo has only one commit, so I found these by comparing against the approved screenshots rather than a diff. I have not committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
